name: PitWall tyre & lap-time model
algorithm: Gradient-boosted decision trees (scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingRegressor, absolute-error loss, monotonic in tyre age, race progress and gap to the car ahead)
curve_settings: curves predicted mid-race, in clean air (5 s gap), stint 2; running maximum applied so older tyres are never faster; beyond the 95th-percentile tyre age seen in the data the curve continues at its recent slope (at least the formula's wear rate)
target: lap time minus the same driver's median clean lap in that race (seconds)
features: Gap to the car ahead (dirty air)
data_filter: dry tyres, green flag only, no in/out laps, no rain, lap 2 onwards, within ±5% of the driver's median, drivers with at least 8 such laps

importance.feature: Gap to the car ahead (dirty air)
